usage: deskops view agents [-h] [--root ROOT] [--herdr HERDR] [--runs RUNS]
                           [--format {text,json}]

Agents view: live Herdr workers and the latest runs of
runs/subagents/index.jsonl.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT           Target repository root.
  --herdr HERDR         Herdr executable.
  --runs RUNS           How many of the latest run index entries to include.
  --format {text,json}  Output format.
